observations: The deployment runs an nginx reverse proxy on port 3009 that forwards traffic to an Express backend on port 3010.
nginx is configured with keepalive_timeout 300 and uses HTTP/1.1 with keep-alive.
Direct external requests to /flag return 401 Unauthorized.
The nginx configuration file is included in the source — it lists an error_page directive that maps 401 responses to an internal URL.
The exact nginx version is identifiable from the Server response header and from the version pinned in the source layout.
